mapper.select: select payment_event_id, payment_id, provider, provider_event_id, event_type, event_status, payload_json, received_at, processed_at from payment_events where payment_id = #{paymentId} order by payment_event_id desc
select count(*) from payment_events where provider = #{provider} and provider_event_id = #{providerEventId}
mapper.insert: insert into payment_events (payment_id, provider, provider_event_id, event_type, event_status, payload_json, received_at, processed_at) values (#{paymentId}, #{provider}, #{providerEventId}, #{eventType}, #{eventStatus}, #{payloadJson}, #{receivedAt}, #{processedAt})
